title: Canine Health Topics
publisher: Cornell University College of Veterinary Medicine — Riney Canine Health Center
geographicScope: General canine health education; local veterinary services and recommendations may vary.
content:
Cornell’s Riney Canine Health Center maintains an expanding directory of expert-developed dog health information. The directory groups resources under topics such as health advisories, allergies, arthritis, pain, weight, and behavior.

The directory is a starting point for locating topic-specific canine health education. General resources cannot diagnose an individual dog, so concerning, persistent, or worsening signs still need veterinary assessment.
